backup.production_rule: Linen stains (D-374). New table linen_stain_reports (RLS on, no grant to any API role) and record_linen_stains_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb): authenticated only, gate submit_cleaning, rows {item_id, qty 1..99, outcome cleaned|needs_replacing|replaced}, replay on the idempotency key (16 to 160 characters), the same key from another person, or with different rows (fingerprint over item, outcome and quantity, order ignored), is 22023 idempotency_key_reused. needs_replacing and replaced lower qty_on_hand (clamped at 0, a cleaner is never refused for a low shelf); a movement-controlled item also gets an adjustment movement. needs_replacing adds to ONE open follow-up task per item (kind linen_replace). Nothing is written to inventory_usage, inventory_purchases or any finance table.
backup.notes: Additive: one table, one function, no existing signature or grant changes, no function body replaced. Independent of the other s120 releases. Apply order does not matter. The checklist release that calls it ships after this applies. 0 of 78 inventory items are movement-controlled in production (read 2026-11-18).

forward_verification.name: linen_rpc_shape_and_grants
forward_verification.query: select (select prosecdef and proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.record_linen_stains_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb)'::regprocedure) and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.record_linen_stains_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.record_linen_stains_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.record_linen_stains_v1(uuid,date,text,text,jsonb)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: linen_table_closed_rls_on
forward_verification.query: select (select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid = 'public.linen_stain_reports'::regclass) and not has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.linen_stain_reports', 'select, insert, update, delete') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.linen_stain_reports', 'select, insert, update, delete') and not has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.linen_stain_reports', 'select, insert, update, delete')

forward_verification.name: linen_key_row_unique_and_outcome_check
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.linen_stain_reports'::regclass and conname = 'linen_stain_reports_key_row' and contype = 'u') and exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.linen_stain_reports'::regclass and contype = 'c' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%needs_replacing%')

forward_verification.name: linen_rows_hash_column_not_null
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'linen_stain_reports' and column_name = 'rows_hash' and is_nullable = 'NO')

rollback.safe_until: Always, with data loss by design: every linen audit row is dropped with the table. The stock the reports took off, the linen_replace tasks they opened and the inventory_audit_log rows (action linen_stain) they wrote stay as ordinary rows.
